Element must carry the IFC GlobalId via bs:ifcGuid.
Element must declare its IFC class via bs:elementType (e.g. 'IfcWall').
Element must point at its owning project (ofProject, IRI).
GoodsReceipt must carry a grnNumber (SAP MBLNR).
GoodsReceipt must link to its PurchaseOrder via bs:forPO.
Incident must have an incidentType (NearMiss / FirstAid / LostTimeInjury / Fatality).
Incident must record an incidentAt timestamp.
personsInvolved must be a positive integer (≥ 1).
Incident must include an immediate-cause note.
Incident must point at the User who reported it (IRI).
Inspection must reference exactly one Activity (IRI).
Inspection must have an inspectedAt timestamp.
Inspection must have an overallResult of 'pass' or 'fail'.
Inspection must declare bs:inspectionCategory of 'quality' or 'safety'.
Issue must carry a project-unique issueId.
issueType must be Clash / Coordination / Design / Construction / Safety / Other.
issueStatus must be Open / InProgress / Resolved / Closed / ReOpened / WontFix.
Issue must point at its owning project (ofProject, IRI).
JointMeasurement must carry a jmId (e.g. JM-0001).
jmStatus must be one of the four bs:JMStatus individuals.
JointMeasurement must identify the contractor signatory (IRI).
JointMeasurement must identify the departmental signatory JE/AE (IRI).
JointMeasurement must reference the BOQ item (IRI).
MaterialIssue must carry a valid material name.
MaterialIssue must carry a valid unit.
MaterialIssue must link to its project via bs:ofProject.
Measurement must reference exactly one BOQ item (IRI).
Measurement must carry a non-negative quantity.
Measurement must point at the User who recorded it (IRI).
Measurement must record a measuredAt timestamp.
measurementNo must be a positive integer (>= 1).
Optional IFC GUID linking this measurement to a bs:Element.
Optional computed flag: true when cumulative amount exceeds project threshold.
A member identity names the model it was asked for.
A member identity covers at least one member (its GlobalId).
NCR must point to exactly one Inspection (IRI).
NCR must point to exactly one Activity (IRI).
NCR status must be one of bs:Open / bs:UnderReview / bs:Closed / bs:Rejected.
NCR must carry the failure note copied from the failed item.
orgSlug must be 2-50 lowercase letters / digits / hyphens (no leading hyphen).
Organisation must have a createdAt timestamp.
orgPlan, when set, must be pilot / project / enterprise / sovereign.
pilotStatus, when set, must be one of bs:Invited / bs:Active / bs:Churned / bs:Converted.
Level-1 approval limit must be below the level-2 limit.
GSTIN must be 15 characters: state code, PAN, entity, Z, checksum.
PAN must be 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter.
CIN must be 21 characters, e.g. U72100AP2025PTC122937.
Payment must carry a paymentId (Tally voucher number).
Payment must link to its project via bs:ofProject.
Photo must include exactly one photoUri.
Photo must have a reportedAt timestamp.
If provided, locationWkt must be POINT(lng lat) format.
If provided, clientId must be a UUID.
ProjectMembership must reference exactly one User (IRI).
ProjectMembership must record a joinedAt timestamp.
PurchaseOrder must carry a poNumber (SAP EBELN).
poStatus must be Open / PartiallyDelivered / FullyDelivered / Cancelled.
RABill must carry a billNo (e.g. RA-1).
billState must be one of the four bs:BillState individuals.
RABill must link to its project via bs:ofProject.
RABill must identify its preparer via bs:preparedBy.
RFI must carry a project-unique rfiId (RFI-NNNN).
RFI must carry a body (the question).
rfiState must be one of bs:RFIDraft / RFISubmitted / RFIUnderReview / RFIAnswered / RFIClosed / RFICancelled.
RFI must record who raised it (raisedBy, IRI).
RFI must point at its owning project (ofProject, IRI).
Recovery must link to its parent RABill via bs:forBill.
RecurrenceAlert must reference exactly one Activity (IRI).
RecurrenceAlert must carry a non-empty defectDescription.
occurrenceCount must be at least 2 — a single occurrence is not a recurrence.
RecurrenceAlert must record a firstSeenAt timestamp.
RecurrenceAlert must record a lastSeenAt timestamp.
RecurrenceAlert must record a generatedAt timestamp.
RecurrenceAlert status must be bs:Open or bs:Acknowledged.
Risk category must be one of the 8 standard buckets.
Probability must be Low / Medium / High / Critical.
Impact must be Low / Medium / High / Critical.
Risk status must be Open / Mitigating / Closed / Accepted.
Risk must record who raised it.
Risk must link to its project via bs:ofProject.
SORItem must link to its parent SORLibrary via bs:partOf.
queryRole must be Any / PM / Director / Auditor.
visualType must be table / number / bar / line / pie.
ScheduleLink must name its predecessor activity (linkSource).
ScheduleLink type must be one of FS / SS / FF / SF.
linkLag, when set, is a single decimal (days).
SignatureEvent must carry a unique signatureId.
SignatureEvent must record the signer (signedBy, IRI of bs:User).
SignatureEvent must record when the signature was applied (signedAt, xsd:dateTime).
signatureProvider must be one of: eMudhra, DigiLocker, Stub.
signaturePurpose must be one of: DrawingApproval, RFIConfirmation, TransmittalApproval, JointMeasurement.
SignatureEvent must reference the signed document (signedDocument, IRI).
SiteIntelligence must link to exactly one Project
SiteIntelligence must have a generatedAt timestamp
peakHeatMonthWBGT must be between 20 and 55 degrees C
aqiZone must be a valid CPCB AQI category
Tower must belong to a project.
Transmittal must carry a project-unique transmittalId (T-NNNN).
Transmittal must record who issued it (issuedBy, IRI).
Transmittal must be issued to at least one user (issuedTo, IRI).
purpose must be ForConstruction / ForReview / ForApproval / ForInformation / AsBuilt / Superseded.
Transmittal must include at least one drawing (includesDrawings, IRI).
Transmittal must point at its owning project (ofProject, IRI).
unitStatus must be Available / Blocked / Booked / Agreement / Registered / Possession.
Unit must belong to a tower.
Unit must reference its unit type.
UnitType must belong to a project.
User must have a valid E.164-format phone number.
User must have a recognised role.
WBS node must carry a wbsCode.
WBS node must carry a wbsName.
WBS node must carry a wbsLevel >= 1.
WBS node must link to its project via bs:ofProject.
WBS node may have at most one parentWBS.
